args.title: Document the limits on report fields in API reference
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The API reference is missing documentation on field limits for report creation and updates. This change will list the maximum number of recipients, the maximum length of a report name, and the maximum number of categories, ensuring users are aware of these constraints before making API calls.

The API reference is missing documentation on the limits for report fields. Specifically, the maximum number of recipients, length of report name, and number of categories should be included to help users validate input before API calls.
